newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shangri-La buys 27.78 pct in Burma firm.
newsitem.headline: Shangri-La buys 27.78 pct in Burma firm.

text.p: Shangri-La hotel Ltd said on Monday it had agreed to buy a 27.78 percent stake in Burma-incorporated Traders Square Company Ltd (TSCL).

The company said in a statement its stake in TSCL would require about US$12.11 million, to paid by way of subscribing for share capital and interest-free shareholders' loans to be paid as and when called by TSCL.

Shangri-La said TSCL had entered into a build, operate and transfer contract and lease on September 10 with the Ministry of Defence, Burma for development and lease of a commercial complex comprising offices, apartments and a retail development on

The land lease is for a 50 year term which begins from the official opening of the complex, targetted around the end of the year 2000. Construction of the complex is scheduled to start by the end of 1996.
Kuok (Singapore) Ltd (KSL), a substantial shareholder of Shangri-La, will hold 11.11 percent of the issued share capital of TSCL.

The company said the estimated cost of the development undertaken by TSCL is at US$109 million and was likely to be 40 percent funded by shareholder's funds and 60 percent by bank loans to be obtained from time to time as required.
Leo Property Management has been appointed the project manger of the commercial complex.
